snippet.title: Ghost Node - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4060200/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer

Ghost Node is a third-person stealth hacking game where every system is both a threat and an opportunity. You play as a freelance hacker infiltrating high-security corporate facilities, 
using cunning, precision, and a versatile drone to outsmart advanced surveillance. Observe, plan, and execute your infiltrations through a network of interconnected systems, where creativity is your greatest weapon.
